correctness.rationale: The proof uses only the reproduced free normal form, the proved identification \(\operatorname{Aut}(D_r)\cong S_r\), the universal property of a free algebra, and Burnside's lemma. For a \(d\)-cycle of a permutation, equivariance reduces the image choice to an element fixed by the \(d\)-th power; such a length-\(k\) element has \(2^{k-1}F_d^k\) choices because the \(a,b\)-word is unchanged and all \(k\) generator letters must be fixed. Grouping by cycle type yields the formula. A separate enumerator agrees in all six tested \((r,k)\) cases. The finite tests are not used to prove the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The invariant is a natural symmetry quotient of the endomorphism semigroup central to the motivating 2026 paper. The formula converts an exponentially large labeled endomorphism layer into an exact partition sum, extends the classical unlabeled functional-digraph count from \(k=1\) to every g-dimonoid length layer, and gives a clean fixed-rank asymptotic showing that generic long-image endomorphisms have no nontrivial generator-relabeling symmetry. This is an exact structural enumeration rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
